items.detail: Full 20-card lists, opponent hidden hand and unrevealed draws are not established. Owner Sightseer reveal establishes only its four shown cards.
Igglybuff changes from active to bench and Eevee becomes active before Boosted Evolution. Expanded retreat input/cost selection not shown; do not invent an Item or Energy payment.
Ranked queue and Master Ball tier are visible; 759 pregame points and Unranked placement visible. Historical TOP badges do not establish current numbered rank; no final ladder-rating screen.
Action time windows are source-local frame bounds, not frame-exact event timestamps. Animation HP values may be intermediate; stable totals reconciled.
Notification overlays upper edge during first KO; action, damage, removal and +1 remain visible.
